resources.string: You have to be logged in to search for members.
This plugin shows a search field on the overview page to search for members of the organisation. It is available to all logged in users. The search results are shown as links to the user profile.
Choose how the name of a search result should be displayed. (default: first name, last name)
If this option is enabled, the plugin will also search for members who live in a certain city. (default: disabled)
Only members of the selected roles are shown in the search results. Without a selection all members of the organisation are searched.
